target_rationale: carrier level; ~610 gnomAD heterozygous LoF carriers occupy it with no severe early phenotype (dosage_headroom.py)
key_asymmetry: NMD acts on mature mRNA; trans-splicing acts on pre-mRNA, so allele 1 is correctable although it is unreachable by readthrough
caveat: a required efficiency is not an achieved one; SMaRT's chronic limitation is the trans- to cis-splicing ratio

precedent.why: dosage-sensitive haploinsufficiency treated by SMaRT, chosen explicitly as a mutation-agnostic approach that preserves endogenous gene regulation
